listening.imageAlt: Bốn chiếc xe tải nhỏ màu vàng đậu thành hàng trước một tòa nhà

audio.text: Some vehicles are being washed.
Some vehicles are parked in a row.
A truck is being loaded with mail.
A garage door is being opened.

options: Some vehicles are parked in a row.
A truck is being loaded with mail.
A garage door is being opened.

why.vi: Các xe đậu thành một hàng: are parked in a row. Không ai rửa hay chất hàng.
why.en: The vans stand in a row, so (B) is right. Nobody is washing or loading them.

questions.trap: Câu (A) dùng cùng chủ đề xe cộ nhưng là hành động bị động mà ảnh không có.

listening.imageAlt: Một chiếc máy bay trên đường băng, hướng về phía người chụp

audio.text: Some passengers are boarding an airplane.
An airplane is flying above the clouds.
A luggage cart is being pulled across the road.
An airplane is on a runway.

options: Some passengers are boarding an airplane.
An airplane is flying above the clouds.
A luggage cart is being pulled across the road.
An airplane is on a runway.

why.vi: Máy bay đang ở trên đường băng: is on a runway. Không có hành khách hay xe hành lý.
why.en: The plane is on the runway, so (D) matches. It is not in the air.

questions.trap: Câu (B) hay làm người học nhầm vì cùng là máy bay, nhưng máy bay đang ở mặt đất.

audio.text: When is the next inventory count?
It counts for twenty percent.
In the storage room.
Ask Ms. Lee, she has the calendar.

options: Ask Ms. Lee, she has the calendar.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: không nói ngày mà chỉ người biết ('Ask Ms. Lee').
why.en: An indirect answer: it points to the person who knows.

questions.trap: (A) lặp count nhưng nghĩa khác; (B) trả lời Where.

audio.text: Where should I put these boxes?
They're pretty heavy.
Yes, boxes are in stock.
Let me check where there's space.

options: Let me check where there's space.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: chưa biết, sẽ kiểm tra chỗ trống.
why.en: An indirect answer: the speaker will check for space first.

questions.trap: (A) lặp chủ đề boxes nhưng không chỉ chỗ đặt.

audio.text: How much will the repairs cost?
I'm waiting for the estimate.
They'll be finished by Friday.
Yes, it's very expensive.

why.vi: Chưa có con số; 'waiting for the estimate' là trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: There is no figure yet, so waiting for the estimate is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (B) trả lời When, không phải How much.

audio.text: Who approved the vacation request?
For about two weeks.
You should ask the HR department.
Yes, it was a nice vacation.

options: You should ask the HR department.
Yes, it was a nice vacation.

why.vi: Khuyên hỏi bộ phận khác là trả lời gián tiếp hợp lệ.
why.en: Pointing to the HR department is a valid indirect answer.

questions.trap: (A) lặp chủ đề nghỉ phép nhưng trả lời How long.

audio.text: Is the conference room available at three?
Let me look at the booking calendar.
Yes, three computers.
The conference starts at nine.

options: Let me look at the booking calendar.

why.vi: Chưa biết nên đi kiểm tra lịch: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: The speaker will check the calendar, an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (B) nghe giống three nhưng nói số máy tính.

audio.text: Why was the flight to Hanoi cancelled?
It leaves from gate nine.
Yes, the flight was full.
I haven't heard the details.

why.vi: Chưa nghe chi tiết: 'I haven't heard' là cách đáp phổ biến.
why.en: 'I haven't heard the details' is a common way to say 'I don't know'.

questions.trap: (B) có Yes nên không hợp với câu hỏi Why.

audio.text: What time does the aquarium café open for school groups?
I opened it with a key.
It's on the website.
Groups of thirty.

options: I opened it with a key.

why.vi: Chỉ nơi có thông tin: 'It's on the website'.
why.en: Pointing to where the information is posted is an indirect answer.

questions.trap: (A) lặp open nhưng nói việc đã làm.

audio.text: Okay, team, the company picnic is three weeks away. Where are we with the venue?
I visited Lakeside Park yesterday. They have a covered pavilion, so we won't have to worry about rain.
And how much do they charge?
Four hundred dollars for the day, which is under our limit. The catch is that we can't bring our own speakers.
That's fine. Eddie, can you handle the food?
Sure. I was thinking of hiring a caterer instead of ordering sandwiches. It's only a little more per person.
Go ahead and get two quotes. Then we'll decide at Friday's meeting.

questions.q: What are the speakers planning?

why.vi: Họ chuẩn bị buổi picnic của công ty, tức là một chuyến đi chơi công ty.
why.en: A company picnic is a company outing.

questions.trap: Dinner/launch không được nhắc tới.

questions.q: What does the woman say about the venue?

why.vi: Pavilion có mái che nên không lo mưa.
why.en: A covered pavilion means it has a roof.

questions.trap: Giá 400 đô, không miễn phí.

questions.q: What will Eddie probably do next?

why.vi: Anh được yêu cầu lấy hai báo giá từ nhà cung cấp thức ăn.
why.en: He is told to get two quotes, i.e. price estimates.

questions.trap: Họ không được mang loa riêng, và chưa chọn sandwiches.

audio.text: Hi, I'm calling about the sponsorship packages for your technology fair in May.
Thanks for your interest. We offer three levels: bronze, silver, and gold. Which one did you have in mind?
We're a small software firm, so probably silver. What does it include?
A booth in the main hall, your logo on the website, and two free passes for staff.
Does the booth come with electricity? We'll be demonstrating our app.
Yes, and Wi-Fi, too. But if you pay by the end of this month, we can add a third pass at no cost.
Perfect. Could you email me the contract today?

questions.q: What is the woman calling about?

why.vi: Cô hỏi về các gói tài trợ cho hội chợ công nghệ.
why.en: She asks about sponsorship packages for a fair.

questions.trap: Booth là một phần của gói, không phải việc cô mua riêng.

questions.q: What can the woman get if she pays early?

why.vi: Trả trước cuối tháng thì được thêm vé thứ ba miễn phí.
why.en: Paying by month-end adds a third free pass.

questions.trap: Giá không giảm, chỉ có thêm vé.

questions.q: What does the woman ask the man to do?

why.vi: Cô nhờ anh gửi hợp đồng qua email, tức là gửi một bản thỏa thuận.
why.en: She asks for the contract by email, which is an agreement.

questions.trap: Cô chưa nhờ ai ghé văn phòng.

audio.text: Welcome, everyone. This is Daniel from our Madrid office, who just joined us for the conference.
Nice to meet you, Daniel. Did you have any trouble with the flight?
A little. It landed an hour late, and my suitcase didn't arrive.
Oh, no. Have you reported it to the airline?
Yes, they said it'll be delivered to the hotel tonight.
In that case, do you want to borrow a jacket? The evening reception is formal.
That's kind of you, but I'm wearing my suit already. I only need my laptop charger, which was in the bag.
We have spares at the registration desk. I'll walk you over.

questions.q: What problem does Daniel mention?

why.vi: Va li của Daniel không đến cùng chuyến bay.
why.en: His suitcase did not arrive.

questions.trap: Chuyến bay chỉ trễ một giờ chứ không bị hủy.

questions.q: What does Daniel need?

why.vi: Anh chỉ cần cục sạc laptop vì nó nằm trong va li.
why.en: He only needs his laptop charger.

questions.trap: Áo khoác được mời nhưng anh từ chối.

questions.q: What will the woman do next?

why.vi: Cô sẽ dẫn Daniel đến quầy đăng ký để lấy đồ sạc dự phòng.
why.en: She will walk him to the registration desk.

questions.trap: Daniel đã báo hãng bay rồi.

audio.text: Mr. Evans, I'm calling from Harper Catering about the awards dinner on the twelfth.
Hello. Is there a problem?
Not exactly. We've had to change the main course because the supplier can't deliver the salmon in time.
Oh. What would you replace it with?
Roast chicken with vegetables, at the same price. We'll also add a vegetarian pasta.
I'd like to ask the committee first. Can I let you know by tomorrow noon?
Of course. After that we won't be able to confirm the order with the farm.

questions.q: Why is the woman calling?

why.vi: Cô báo món chính phải thay đổi vì nhà cung cấp không giao cá hồi kịp.
why.en: She informs him the main course must change.

questions.trap: Chưa ai hủy bữa tối.

questions.q: Why can the original dish not be served?
options: An ingredient will not arrive on time

why.vi: Cá hồi không thể giao kịp, tức là nguyên liệu không đến đúng hạn.
why.en: The salmon cannot be delivered in time.

questions.trap: Giá giữ nguyên nên giá không phải lý do.

questions.q: What does the man say he will do?

why.vi: Anh sẽ hỏi ý kiến ủy ban trước khi trả lời.
why.en: He wants to ask the committee first.

questions.trap: Món chay đã được thêm sẵn, không phải việc anh làm.

audio.text: Hi, Liam. Have you finalized the speaker list for next week's seminar?
Almost. Dr. Chen confirmed, but Ms. Okafor might have to cancel because of a family matter.
That would leave a gap on Wednesday morning. Do we have a backup?
I thought of asking Mr. Hall from the Denver branch. He did a great presentation at the sales meeting.
Good idea. Do you think he'd have time on such short notice?
I'll find out this afternoon. If he says yes, I'll also reprint the agenda.
Please do, and let the printing office know it's a rush job.

questions.q: What are the speakers mainly discussing?

why.vi: Họ bàn về danh sách diễn giả cho hội thảo.
why.en: They discuss who will speak at the seminar.

questions.trap: Branch/Sales là nơi anh Hall làm việc, không phải chủ đề.

questions.q: Why might Ms. Okafor not attend?
options: She is on a business trip

why.vi: Cô có việc gia đình, tức là một vấn đề cá nhân.
why.en: A family matter is a personal issue.

questions.trap: Không ai nói cô bị ốm.

questions.q: What will the man probably do this afternoon?

why.vi: Anh sẽ hỏi xem ông Hall có thể thay thế không.
why.en: He will find out whether Mr. Hall is available.

questions.trap: Agenda in lại chỉ khi Hall đồng ý.

audio.text: Good morning, and welcome to the Westfield Business Expo. Before the opening speech, I would like to go over a few details. Registration is at the main entrance, where you will get your name badge and a program. Today's workshops will be held in Halls A and B on the second floor. Because the workshop on social media is already full, we have added a second session at four o'clock in Hall C. Lunch will be served from twelve to two in the garden area. If it rains, we will move it indoors. Please wear your badge at all times. Enjoy the Expo.

questions.q: Where is the announcement most likely being made?

why.vi: Từ "Business Expo", đăng ký, hội thảo cho thấy đây là triển lãm thương mại.
why.en: Business Expo, registration and workshops point to a trade show.

questions.trap: Restaurant sai vì bữa trưa chỉ là một phần của chương trình.

questions.q: Why was a second session added?

why.vi: Buổi hội thảo về mạng xã hội đã kín chỗ nên thêm buổi thứ hai.
why.en: The first workshop is already full.

questions.trap: It might rain chỉ liên quan đến bữa trưa.

questions.q: What are attendees asked to do?

why.vi: Người nghe được dặn đeo thẻ tên mọi lúc.
why.en: They are asked to wear their badges at all times.

questions.trap: Register in Hall C sai vì đăng ký ở lối vào chính.

audio.text: Hi, Ms. Park. This is Natalie from Bluebird Events about next month's charity dinner. I have good news and a small problem. The good news is that the Grand Hotel can host us on the twelfth, and they will give us a ten percent discount because we booked early. The problem is that the hotel's stage is smaller than we expected, so the band will not fit. I have asked two other bands who can play on a smaller stage, and I will send you their prices this afternoon. Could you decide by tomorrow? The hotel needs a final answer by Friday.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
options: To give an update on an event

why.vi: Natalie báo tin tốt và một vấn đề nhỏ về bữa tối từ thiện.
why.en: She gives news about the charity dinner.

questions.trap: Cancel a dinner sai vì bữa tối vẫn diễn ra ngày mười hai.

questions.q: What is the problem?

why.vi: Sân khấu nhỏ hơn dự kiến nên ban nhạc không vừa.
why.en: The hotel's stage is smaller than expected.

questions.trap: Date not free sai vì khách sạn nhận tổ chức vào ngày mười hai.

questions.q: What will the speaker do this afternoon?

why.vi: Cô sẽ gửi giá của hai ban nhạc khác trong chiều nay.
why.en: She will send the prices of two other bands.

questions.trap: Call the band sai vì cô đã liên hệ và sẽ gửi giá, không phải gọi thêm.

questions.q: The first shipment was damaged. ____, we ordered a replacement.

why.vi: Hỏng nên đặt lại: quan hệ nguyên nhân.
why.en: Damage led to a reorder: cause and effect.

questions.trap: "Although" là liên từ, không đứng đầu câu với dấu phẩy này.

questions.q: The café opened a patio. ____ addition, sales rose 12 percent.

why.vi: Cụm cố định: in addition.
why.en: Fixed phrase: in addition.

questions.trap: "On addition" sai.

questions.q: The register is broken. ____, customers must pay by card.

why.vi: Hỏng máy nên phải trả bằng thẻ: hậu quả.
why.en: A broken register leads to card payment: result.

questions.trap: "Instead of" là giới từ.

questions.q: Mr. Ray hired two designers. ____ will start next week.

why.vi: Chủ ngữ thay cho "two designers".
why.en: A subject pronoun for "two designers".

questions.trap: "Them" là tân ngữ.

questions.q: Our new cleaning schedule is more ____ than the old one.

why.vi: Sau "is more" cần tính từ.
why.en: After "is more" we need an adjective.

questions.trap: "Efficiently" sai vì sau "is" cần tính từ.

questions.q: Attendance fell last year. ____, the director plans a new campaign.

why.vi: Giảm khách nên lập chiến dịch: hậu quả.
why.en: The drop leads to the campaign: result.

questions.trap: "In contrast" chỉ đối lập.

questions.q: Tickets are ____ at the door or online.

why.vi: Sau "are" cần tính từ.
why.en: After "are" an adjective.

questions.trap: "Availability" là danh từ.

questions.q: The brochure explains the rules. Please read ____ carefully.

why.vi: Đại từ tân ngữ thay "the rules".
why.en: An object pronoun for "the rules".

questions.trap: "They" là chủ ngữ.

questions.q: Mr. Park will retire in June. His successor, ____ name has not been announced, will start in July.

why.vi: "Whose name" chỉ sở hữu.
why.en: "Whose name" shows possession.

questions.trap: "Who name" sai.

questions.q: Please ____ the enclosed form and return it by mail.

why.vi: Câu mệnh lệnh dùng động từ nguyên mẫu.
why.en: An imperative takes the base verb.

questions.trap: "Completion" là danh từ.

passages.title: Cleanliness standards
passages.text:
MEMO
To: All floor staff
From: Operations Manager
Date: March 3
Subject: Cleanliness standards

Following several [1] customer reviews about cleanliness, we will introduce new daily checks starting next week. Each staff member is [2] for keeping his or her own area tidy, including counters, display windows, and walkways. [3] A checklist will be posted near the staff entrance, and supervisors will sign it at the end of every shift. Please make sure that all cleaning supplies are returned to the storage room [4] closing time.

Thank you for your cooperation.

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: Trước danh từ "customer reviews" cần tính từ: "negative" (đánh giá tiêu cực).
why.en: Before the noun phrase "customer reviews" we need an adjective: "negative".

questions.trap: Đừng chọn "negatively" vì trạng từ không bổ nghĩa trực tiếp cho danh từ.

questions.q: Blank [2]

why.vi: Cụm cố định "be responsible for": cần tính từ sau "is".
why.en: The fixed phrase is "be responsible for", so an adjective follows "is".

questions.trap: "responsibility" cũng đi với "for" nhưng sau "is" phải là tính từ.

questions.q: Blank [3]
options: The café will introduce a new seasonal menu in April.
Every area will be inspected at least once per shift.
Several tanks were repaired last year.
Some customers prefer to pay by credit card.

why.vi: Câu sau nhắc "checklist" và "supervisors will sign it", nên câu chèn nói về việc kiểm tra khu vực mỗi ca.
why.en: The next sentence mentions a checklist signed by supervisors, so the missing sentence is about inspecting areas each shift.

questions.trap: Câu C có "tanks" nghe đúng ngành nhưng không liên quan đến checklist vệ sinh.

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: "before closing time" nghĩa là trước giờ đóng cửa; hợp với việc trả dụng cụ về kho.
why.en: "Before closing time" fits returning supplies to storage ahead of closing.

questions.trap: "until closing time" nghĩa là kéo dài đến giờ đóng cửa, trái với ý trả đồ trước đó.

passages.title: Delayed delivery
passages.text:
To: Mr. Okafor
From: Customer Service, Marlow Supply
Subject: Your order of 40 filter cartridges

Dear Mr. Okafor,

Thank you for your order of 40 filter cartridges. Unfortunately, we are [1] to deliver them on March 10 as planned because of a shortage at our warehouse. [2] The new delivery date is March 17. If you need the items sooner, we can send half of the order by express courier, [3] you would pay the extra shipping charge. We sincerely [4] for the inconvenience and appreciate your patience.

Regards,
Customer Service Team

questions.q: Blank [1]

why.vi: "be unable to + V" là cấu trúc chuẩn: không thể giao hàng. "Impossible" không đi với người làm chủ ngữ ("we are impossible").
why.en: "Be unable to + verb" is the standard pattern. "Impossible" cannot describe a person subject.

questions.trap: "unavailable" gần nghĩa nhưng không đi với "to deliver".

questions.q: Blank [2]
options: Our warehouse is open from Monday to Friday.
We have therefore rescheduled your shipment.
Please complete the enclosed survey about our website.
All cartridges come with a one-year warranty.

why.vi: Câu trước nói giao hàng bị hoãn, câu sau nêu ngày giao mới, nên câu chèn là "đã dời lịch giao hàng".
why.en: The delay is explained before and a new date follows, so the missing sentence announces the rescheduling.

questions.trap: Câu A nhắc "warehouse" lặp từ khóa nhưng không dẫn tới "ngày giao mới".

questions.q: Blank [3]

why.vi: "provided that" (với điều kiện là) nối đề nghị gửi nửa đơn hàng với điều kiện trả thêm phí.
why.en: "Provided that" sets a condition: half the order ships if the customer pays the extra charge.

questions.trap: "so that" chỉ mục đích nên câu thành vô nghĩa: "để bạn sẽ trả thêm phí".

questions.q: Blank [4]

why.vi: Sau "we sincerely" và chủ ngữ "we" cần động từ chia: "apologize for".
why.en: After the subject "we" and the adverb "sincerely" we need a verb: "apologize".

questions.trap: "apology" là danh từ nên không đứng ở vị trí động từ.

title.vi: Đọc ngữ cảnh: manh mối nằm ở câu bên cạnh

rule.vi: Một số chỗ trống không giải được bằng một câu. Hãy đọc câu trước và câu sau để tìm từ nối (therefore, however, in addition) và đại từ thay thế (they, it, them).
rule.en: Some blanks cannot be solved from one sentence. Read the sentence before and after to find linking words (therefore, however, in addition) and pronoun references (they, it, them).

theory.formula: Cause -> As a result / Therefore | Contrast -> However | Add -> In addition

examples.en: The first shipment was damaged. Therefore, we ordered a replacement.
examples.vi: Hỏng nên đặt lại: quan hệ nguyên nhân.

examples.en: Mr. Ray hired two designers. They will start next week.
examples.vi: "They" thay cho hai nhà thiết kế.

examples.en: The brochure explains the rules. Please read them carefully.

theory.tip: Mẹo thi: trước khi chọn từ nối, tự hỏi "câu 2 là hậu quả, đối lập hay thêm ý của câu 1?". Part 6 giống đi lặn: đọc hết đường hầm rồi mới chọn lối ra.

passages.title: Riverside Hospitality Forum
passages.text:
Riverside Hospitality Forum - Program
Friday, October 17

8:30 A.M.   Registration and coffee (Main Lobby)
9:00 A.M.   Opening remarks: Carla Moreno, Forum Chair (Hall A)
9:30 A.M.   Keynote: "Designing Guest Experiences," Dr. Samuel Ito (Hall A)
10:45 A.M.  Breakout sessions (choose one)
            Session 1: Managing Seasonal Staff (Room 201)
            Session 2: Using Guest Feedback (Room 202)
            Session 3: Event Budgeting Basics (Room 203)
12:00 P.M.  Lunch (Garden Terrace)
1:15 P.M.   Panel: The Future of Boutique Hotels (Hall A)
2:30 P.M.   Workshop: Hands-On Booking Software (Room 201)*
4:00 P.M.   Closing remarks and prize drawing (Hall A)

*Limited to 30 participants. Sign up at registration.
Note: Session 2 will be led by Hana Weiss in place of Peter Lund, who is unable to attend.

questions.q: Where will the keynote speech take place?

why.vi: Dòng 9:30 A.M.: Keynote ... (Hall A).
why.en: The 9:30 A.M. keynote is listed as taking place in Hall A.

questions.q: When can participants sign up for the workshop?

why.vi: Chú thích *: "Sign up at registration", tức lúc 8:30 A.M.
why.en: The footnote says to sign up at registration.

questions.trap: Workshop diễn ra 2:30 P.M. nhưng đăng ký phải làm từ lúc check-in buổi sáng.

questions.q: What is suggested about the breakout sessions?
options: They all cover the same topic
They are led by Dr. Ito
Attendees can go to only one at that time

why.vi: Ba phiên diễn ra cùng lúc 10:45 và ghi "choose one", nên mỗi người chỉ dự được một.
why.en: Three sessions run at the same time and attendees must "choose one."

questions.trap: Giờ lunch là 12:00, sau các breakout, nên "after lunch" sai.

passages.title: School group itinerary
passages.text:
Blue Harbor Aquarium - School Group Itinerary
Class 5B, Tuesday, March 11

9:30   Arrival and check-in (Group Entrance)
9:45   Welcome talk with Ms. Tran (Education Room)
10:15  Groups A and B: Jellyfish Gallery | Groups C and D: Touch Pool
11:00  Groups switch activities
11:45  Lunch (Picnic Area; Education Room if raining)
12:30  Feeding demonstration at Penguin Cove
1:15   Gift shop (optional; students may bring up to $10)
1:45   Departure

Reminders: Please wear closed shoes. Adult chaperones receive free admission at a ratio of one adult for every 8 students. Bus parking is at Gate 3. Teachers must confirm final numbers by March 7.

questions.q: What will Groups C and D do at 11:00?

why.vi: Lúc 10:15 nhóm C, D ở Touch Pool; đến 11:00 hai nhóm "switch", nên sang Jellyfish Gallery.
why.en: Groups C and D start at the Touch Pool and switch to the Jellyfish Gallery at 11:00.

questions.trap: Touch Pool là hoạt động đầu tiên của nhóm C, D chứ không phải sau 11:00.

questions.q: What must teachers do by March 7?

why.vi: "Teachers must confirm final numbers by March 7."
why.en: Teachers must confirm the final numbers by March 7.

questions.q: If 24 students attend, how many adult chaperones will receive free admission?

why.vi: Cứ 8 học sinh có 1 người lớn miễn phí: 24 chia 8 bằng 3.
why.en: One free adult for every 8 students means 24 students get 3.

questions.trap: Chọn "Eight" là nhầm tỉ lệ 8 học sinh với số người lớn.

passages.title: Regional Tourism Summit
passages.text:

questions.q: Where will lunch be served?

why.vi: Dòng 12:30 P.M. ghi rõ: Lunch (Garden Terrace).
why.en: The 12:30 P.M. entry lists the Garden Terrace.

questions.trap: Main Lobby là nơi ăn sáng và bốc thăm, không phải bữa trưa.

questions.q: Who will give the opening remarks?

why.vi: Lúc 9:00 A.M. là "Opening remarks, Celia Brandt". Dr. Haddad nói bài keynote sau đó.
why.en: Ms. Brandt delivers the opening remarks at 9:00 A.M.

questions.q: What are attendees asked to do at the registration desk?

why.vi: Cuối lịch: "Please sign up at the registration desk" ngay sau câu workshop có giới hạn chỗ.
why.en: Seating is limited, so attendees should sign up for workshops at the desk.

questions.trap: Bữa trưa đã bao gồm trong phí đăng ký nên không phải trả thêm.

passages.title: Annual awards dinner
passages.text:
To: All employees
From: Nadia Petrov, Events Coordinator
Subject: Annual awards dinner
Date: October 6

Dear colleagues,

The annual awards dinner will be held on Saturday, November 15, in the ballroom of the Lantern Hotel. Doors open at 6:30 P.M., and dinner will be served at 7:30 P.M.

Because the hotel needs a final head count, please RSVP by October 31 using the link below. Each employee may bring one guest. Valet parking is free for all attendees.

We hope to see you there!

Nadia Petrov

questions.q: Why was the e-mail sent?
options: To invite employees to an event

why.vi: Email mở đầu bằng thông tin về buổi tiệc và yêu cầu RSVP, tức là lời mời.
why.en: The e-mail gives details of the dinner and asks for RSVPs, so it is an invitation.

questions.trap: "Awards" dễ khiến chọn nomination, nhưng bài không hề xin đề cử.

questions.q: By when should employees respond?

why.vi: "Please RSVP by October 31."
why.en: The e-mail asks employees to RSVP by October 31.

questions.trap: 15/11 là ngày diễn ra tiệc, không phải hạn phản hồi.

questions.q: What does "head count" most likely mean in the e-mail?
options: The names of the award winners
The total number of people attending

why.vi: Khách sạn cần "final head count" để chuẩn bị, tức là tổng số người tham dự, vì thế mới cần RSVP.
why.en: The hotel needs the total number of attendees, which is why guests must RSVP.

questions.trap: Không có tên người thắng giải hay chi phí nào được yêu cầu.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: A small boat brings six guests in dark suits to the Aurelia. The Captain welcomes them with a big smile.
story.vi: Một chiếc thuyền nhỏ đưa sáu vị khách mặc vest tối đến tàu Aurelia. Thuyền trưởng đón họ với nụ cười lớn.

story.speaker: BAO
story.en: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to our launch event. Please enjoy the food. Tomorrow you will see the reef.
story.vi: Quý vị, chào mừng đến sự kiện ra mắt. Xin dùng bữa. Ngày mai quý vị sẽ thấy rạn san hô.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: Huy carries a tray. He hears three voices behind a curtain.
story.vi: Huy bưng một khay. Huy nghe ba giọng nói sau tấm rèm.

story.speaker: NARRATOR
story.en: Guest: "How many specimens can we get?" Bảo: "Thousands." Guest 2: "And the price?" Bảo: "Ask me after the harvest."
story.vi: Khách: "Chúng ta lấy được bao nhiêu mẫu?" Bảo: "Hàng nghìn." Khách 2: "Giá thì sao?" Bảo: "Hỏi tôi sau vụ thu hoạch."

story.speaker: BESUA
story.en: Harvest? Sứa đâu phải rau cải. Em hong thích chữ đó. :33
story.vi: Thu hoạch? Sứa đâu phải rau cải. Em không thích chữ đó. :33

letter.vi: Bé iu, hôm nay Part 6 nè. Đọc cả đoạn, vì đáp án nằm ở câu trước hoặc câu sau. Từ THE thường dẫn về cái đã nhắc ở câu trước, như một sợi dây nối hai câu. Hihii shương shương.
letter.en: My love, Part 6 today. Read the whole passage, because the answer is in the sentence before or after. The word THE often points back to something already mentioned, like a thread between two sentences. Hihii shương shương.

beSua: Actually không có nghĩa là "hiện tại" nha! Actually = thực ra. Còn "hiện tại" là currently. Hihi, false friend! :33
Eventually = cuối cùng thì, không phải "có thể". Còn "possibly" mới là có thể. Dọ!
Attend không đi với to: "attend the meeting". Còn "invite someone TO the party" thì có to. Hihi!

audio.text: Where is the new intern sitting?
Please sit down.
Two interns.
I haven't met her yet.

why.vi: Chưa gặp nên không biết: trả lời gián tiếp.
why.en: Not having met her means the speaker does not know.

questions.trap: (A) lặp sit nhưng là câu mời.

audio.text: Have you received the updated contract?
The contract is for two years.
Yes, I'd like an update.
My assistant handles my mail.

options: The contract is for two years.

why.vi: Trả lời gián tiếp: để trợ lý xử lý thư nên chưa rõ.
why.en: The assistant handles the mail, so the speaker cannot confirm.
